tasks.name: Set up project structure
tasks.description: Initialize the project with the necessary folder structure and dependencies.

tasks.name: Create text input field
tasks.description: Design and implement a text input field for users to enter notes.

tasks.name: Add save button
tasks.description: Add a button that allows users to save their notes.

tasks.name: Implement save notes functionality
tasks.description: Write backend logic to save notes entered by the user.

tasks.name: Set up database for storing notes
tasks.description: Create a database schema to store user notes.

tasks.name: Connect frontend to backend
tasks.description: Ensure the frontend can communicate with the backend to save notes.

tasks.name: Test note-saving functionality
tasks.description: Test the application to ensure notes are saved correctly.

tasks.name: Deploy application
tasks.description: Deploy the note-taking app to a hosting platform.

T1.implementation_approach: Organize the project into folders for frontend, backend, and shared resources; initialize version control.
T1.notes: Ensure a clear and scalable structure for future development.

T2.implementation_approach: Create a text input field using HTML and style it with CSS for user-friendly interaction.
T2.notes: Ensure the input field is accessible and supports multiline input if needed.

T3.implementation_approach: Add a button element in the UI and style it appropriately; attach a click event listener.
T3.notes: Ensure the button is visually distinct and responsive.

T4.implementation_approach: Write a function to capture input data and send it to the backend via an API call.
T4.notes: Validate input data before sending it to the backend.

T5.implementation_approach: Set up a database (e.g., SQLite, MongoDB) with a table/collection for storing notes.
T5.notes: Define fields for note content, timestamps, and any necessary metadata.

T6.implementation_approach: Use a framework like Express.js to create API endpoints and connect them to the database.
T6.notes: Ensure proper error handling and CORS configuration.

T7.implementation_approach: Test the note-saving functionality by simulating user input and verifying database entries.
T7.notes: Include edge cases and invalid input scenarios in testing.

T8.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using a platform like Heroku, Vercel, or AWS, and configure environment variables.
T8.notes: Test the deployed application to ensure all features work as expected.
